text:
devin: Heads up — we saw another OOM on shard-prod-12 at ~02:14 UTC. Looks like the same long-tail kv-residency growth we saw in the last postmortem. I attached heap summary and brief timeline: https://logs.company/oom/1718123456 :point_down:

sasha: can you paste the quick heap tail?

devin: sure — snippet from heap-monitor:
```
heap.used_mb: 12736 -> 24612 over 3.5h
kv.residency.count: 1.2M -> 4.8M
gc.pause.ms: 12 -> 28
last.gc.walls: increase correlated with big batch writes
```

maria: ugh. pattern matches earlier fragmentation + sticky-residency. I'll own eviction-policy tests. Plan: run softlimit rollout to 70% on canary nodes tomorrow 09:00 PST, collect rejection/latency metrics for 48h.

sasha: I'll take profiling ownership — run alloc-trace + flamegraphs across the service for the week, look for delayed free paths and unusual object survivors. Target: initial findings by Wed EOD.

leo: infra note — autoscaler didn't add capacity because memory spike looked like slow leak rather than sustained CPU or queue growth. I'll add metric-based autoscale rule (kv.residency.growth_rate > 1.5x for 5m) and alert. Doing a deploy change in canary now.

anika: I'll update the postmortem follow-ups doc with owners, JIRA links, and deadlines. Will also add a recurring check (weekly residency heatmap) to prevent regression.

devin: sweet. Can we enumerate concrete action items here so we can paste into the tracker? short lines pls.

maria: Action: run softlimit canary -> owner: maria -> due: 2026-03-25 09:00 PST -> success criteria: <5% request failures, 10% drop in peak residency

sasha: Action: run full alloc profiling + flamegraphs -> owner: sasha -> due: 2026-03-25 EOD -> success criteria: identify top 3 survivor paths and PRs for fixes

leo: Action: add autoscale rule + alert -> owner: leo -> due: 2026-03-24 noon PST -> success criteria: autoscale triggers for 2 mimic scenarios in staging

anika: Action: update postmortem tracker + add weekly heatmap job -> owner: anika -> due: 2026-03-24 EOD -> success criteria: tracker updated with links and recurring job created

devin: Action: run KV GC tuning experiments (reduce fragmentation) -> owner: devin -> due: 2026-03-30 -> success criteria: 15% reduction in avg fragment size and lower GC pauses

ops-bot: Created issue: INF-4821 - "Long-tail KV residency spike / OOM - followups" (https://jira.company/browse/INF-4821). Assigned: maria, sasha, leo, anika, devin.

maria: small note — before we flip softlimit, we should snapshot hot-keys and run hot-key eviction simulation. I can add that to canary prep.

sasha: also adding a small test to inject delayed frees into staging to reproduce growth pattern. if anyone has a synthetic workload script, ping me.

leo: staging script: https://git.company/tests/kv-residency-sim. I can extend it to hit delayed free timeline.

anika: I'll block 30m tomorrow at 10:30 PST for a quick sync after canary starts — so we can review metrics and decide next steps.

devin: thanks all. quick followups: please post PR links and measurement dashboards in INF-4821. I'll run a nightly job to gather a short report for the oncall channel for the next week. :thumbsup:

sasha: ack. starting profiling now.

maria: starting canary prep, will post checklist in the issue.

leo: autoscale change pushed to canary. monitoring for false positives.

ops-bot: Incident note appended to INF-4821: "Recurring pattern observed; follow-ups assigned; canary + profiling in progress."

anika: updated tracker with owners and due dates — link: https://docs.company/postmortems/INF-4821/followups

devin: closing loop — will reopen if the canary shows regression or if any owner can't meet deadline. otherwise we'll reconvene next Fri retro to review long-term mitigations and API-level guards. :calendar:

sasha: thanks — will report back Wed with flamegraphs.

maria: will post canary results mid-day Fri.

leo: will validate autoscale triggers in staging by EOD tomorrow.

anika: adding recurring weekly check to ops calendar.

devin: end."
